description: This file defines the MatchersApiController class, which provides API endpoints for listing, retrieving, and managing matcher entities within the Goteo project. It handles JSON responses for matcher data and includes security checks for user permissions.

classes.name: MatchersApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests related to matchers, including listing, detail retrieval, and image uploads.

methods.name: matchersAction
methods.description: Returns a list of matchers, with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getSafeProject
methods.description: Sanitizes and returns selected project data for API responses.

methods.name: getSafeUser
methods.description: Sanitizes and returns selected user data for API responses.

methods.name: getSafeMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes matcher data if accessible by the current user, throws exception if not found or unauthorized.

methods.name: matcherAction
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a specific matcher.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles image upload requests for authenticated users.
